title: Core: Shape tween interpolation
description: Unit tests for shape tween interpolation. When tweenType='shape' on a frame, the renderer should produce intermediate shapes. Currently shape tweening may just return start/end frames without interpolation. Test that getDisplayObjectsAtFrame returns non-null results for all frames in a shape tween span. If interpolation not implemented, document with todos. Tests in packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/shape-tween.test.ts.
